notes.title: Super Dungeon Boy 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31988228/268574fd42ec10ad62f70c894c2065df4f5ce90f.png[/img]

[b]Super Dungeon Boy 2[/b] is more challenging! A new version so special it will set your hands on fire and freeze your brain.

[h1]What were the improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Easier to play. Accurate shot and accurate dash.
[*] 3 difficulty modes: Easy, Normal and ULTRA RAPID FIRE!
[*] Now you will be able to face bosses... they are furious.
[*] Challenging levels... and each with its own achievements.
[*] Humor, easter eggs and crazy ideas.
[*] Lots of secret areas to explore.
[/list]
[h3]Check out all the news on the store page:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/799540/Super_Dungeon_Boy_2/

notes.title: Demo version available
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the demo version of [b]Super Dungeon Boy: Mega Fire[/b]:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/852710
Let's separate some early stages so you can try them out. Some news may be noticed immediately, others will be less noticeable.
One of the great news, and that is present in the demo version, is the ice skill. An ability that can be used in defensive or offensive form. Be that as it may, this new skill is of great importance and will bring great advantages to anyone who knows how to use it at the right time.

Remembering that it is very important for us that players leave comments about positives and negatives while the game is in development. We are very grateful for this.

notes.title: About the Launch
notes.content:
[b]Super Dungeon Boy: Mega Fire[/b] will be a game full of news and challenges. We are working hard to make the game beautiful, light, fun, diverse, challenging and engaging.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31988228/e902276fca3b8de635ce7f601f79459a79d52f7a.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New mechanics - New game mechanics have been added. Everything to make the game more diverse and fun.
[*]New Enemies - New Enemies have been added to make fighting more challenging.
[*]New abilities - Now you will count not only your bow and arrow, but with new abilities.
[*]Cutscenes - We want to add some cutscenes to better explain this new adventure.
[*]Stability and performance - All without impacting game performance. The game remains lightweight and runs even on older video cards.
[/list]
But for all this to happen we ask you to wait a few more days. The release was postponed to April, but that does not mean you will not be able to try out the news later this month. Because we are preparing a demo version to evaluate reviews and suggestions submitted by you.

Soon we will give more information about the demo version. Be sure to follow the news and send your suggestions.

notes.title: Devlog: Warming the weather!
notes.content:
Looking forward to the release of Super Dungeon Boy: Mega Fire? You can be sure that we are very anxious too !!!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31988228/018048350978d8d8545c0579a9f06c8e0dc3efe1.png[/img]

It takes a few days for our boy to show what he has learned again. Mortal challenges, ruthless enemies and hidden secrets beyond deep. But nothing can stop our conquering boy, as always.

We are working on every detail. Especially on what was asked by the community. Take the opportunity to leave your request:

[b]What do you want for the next game?[/b]

notes.title: DevLog: Walls
notes.content:
The intention of this post is to be able to interact with the players. We will be attentive in replying comments made here or in the TIGSource forum.
We've lit the fire, but you can still stick your hand in the dough! We want to hear from you what you expect to see in this new version.

[url=https://forums.tigsource.com/index.php?topic=63993.msg1371783#msg1371783]TIGForums / DevLog: Walls[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31988228/783fbd4556cd435cda8b12d6ccde764b79b8d30e.png[/img]

One of the novelties are the moving walls.
No pressure... but better not to think too much !!! ːsteamboredː

The only thing that can save you from them is your positioning. Enemies are a dangerous combination. But the walls are as dangerous to the enemies as to you. ːsteammockingː

But not all the news is against you!
Next time I will talk about new skills. ːsteamhappyː
